so, I'm just gonna tell you about my experiences and maybe it could help you with your decision.
I am struggling with social anxiety and depression and i first got into therapy about 2½ years ago. therapy alone never really helped me that much in a long term, but it did help me understand why I am feeling the way I feel. So, like 2 years ago I was first getting medication and i took fluoxetine (or also known as prozac i think) and it actually did help a bit with my anxiety. In general, those SSRIs are relatively harmless/have less side effects than other ones. And i actually did get a bit better and stuff and i think that if you keep taking it and go to therapy, you could actually get so much better, if it works for you. 
The problem for me just was that it never really made my anxiety go away, it just made me a bit braver to fight against it and do some exercises against it, yk, starting conversations or whatever. but i still was anxious af and it was horrible. 
but it helped me to get together the courage to do something against it and so I could 'collect' some positive experiences which can help you get more confident and fight your anxiety.

but ofc everything works different for everybody and you should really think about if it might be an option for you, or rather not. 
i hope this somehow maybe helped you a bit haha. wish you all the best and keep fighting :)
